legend: In a very distant future, in the last year of graduation at IME, the VFs are coming for César and once again he got low grades. The dream of needing no more than $$$4$$$ to pass the semester is far away, but there is hope, at least for the Encryption discipline.

The professor gave a list of exercises (to raise the VE grade), but this time he got too wicked. To solve the list, César has to decrypt $$$q$$$ messages. The algorithm is quite simple, but there is a hard math part. For every message, César has to find some integer $$$x$$$ such that $$$n^x \equiv 1 \pmod m$$$, where $$$m$$$ and $$$n$$$ are parameters already calculated from the algorithm.
Finishing these calculations is all he need to hand the list. As César needs more than $$$4$$$ on all other disciplines, he doesn't have time to finish it, so you will have to help him.
input: The first line of input contains an integer $$$q$$$ ($$$1 \le q \le 10^5$$$) — the number of messages to decrypt.
The next $$$q$$$ lines contains, each, two integers, $$${n_i}$$$ and $$${m_i}$$$ ($$$1 \le n_i  \lt  m_i \le 10^6$$$) — the parameters $$${n_i}$$$ and $$${m_i}$$$ for the $$$i$$$-th query.
output: For each $$$n_i$$$ and $$$m_i$$$ from the input, print an integer $$$x_i$$$ ($$$0 \le x_i \le 10^6$$$) such that $$${n_i}^{x_i} \equiv 1 \pmod{m_i}$$$.

legend: 在遥远的未来，在 IME 毕业的最后一年，VF 们正在寻找 Cesar，而他再次得到了低分。只需要 $$$4$$$ 就能通过学期的梦想已经遥不可及，但至少对于加密学科来说，还是有希望的。
教授给了我一份习题清单(为了提高我的VE分数），但这次他太恶毒了。为了破解这个列表，csamar必须解密$$$q$$$条消息。这个算法很简单，但是有一个很难的数学部分。对于每条消息，csamar必须找到一个整数$$$x$$$，使得$$$n^x \equiv 1 \pmod m$$$，其中$$$m$$$和$$$n$$$是已经从算法中计算出来的参数。
他只需要完成这些计算就可以拿到清单了。由于César在所有其他学科上需要超过$$$4$$$，他没有时间完成它，因此您必须帮助他。
input: 第一行输入包含一个整数 $$$q$$$ ($$$1 \le q \le 10^5$$$）--要解密的报文数量。
output: 对于输入中的每个$$$n_i$$$和$$$m_i$$$，打印一个整数$$$x_i$$$ ($$$0 \le x_i \le 10^6$$$)，使得$$${n_i}^{x_i} \equiv 1 \pmod{m_i}$$$。
